svg.title: Digitisation document journey: onboarding fork, upload, extract with retry loop, validate, approve or reject, patient match, promote with failure loop
svg.desc: From prospect through sign-in or manual onboarding, upload, watcher parse with a fail-to-reprocess loop, validation queue and review, an approve-or-reject fork, patient match split, promote to records with a failure-back-to-review loop, ending at document linked. Green nodes verified, amber partial, red gap.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What decides sign in versus onboarding for a prospect?')
sendPrompt('Why is self-serve sign up a gap?')
sendPrompt('How does founder-run manual onboarding via provision_practice.py work?')
sendPrompt('How does sign in and capability hydration work?')
sendPrompt('What does the capability-gated nav show a Type-C user?')
sendPrompt('How does upload land a document in storage and the queue?')
sendPrompt('How does the watcher parse and extract, and what happens on parse failure?')
sendPrompt('What is the parse-fail to reprocess loop?')
sendPrompt('What is in the validation queue?')
sendPrompt('Why is the review screen partial — derived values shown as extracted?')
sendPrompt('What happens at the approve or reject fork?')
sendPrompt('What does the reject path do?')
sendPrompt('How does the patient match split work — candidates vs no candidates?')
sendPrompt('What does the confirm modal do?')
sendPrompt('Explain Fix A, the auto create-new patient when no candidates')
sendPrompt('Continue to the promote step and the post-approve fan-out')
